name: @merces/poi-device
description: What runs on the issuer's and the attestor's own device. The issuer's: a quarterly ProofOfIncome report (zkTLS session, income commitment, proof generation, attestation request, report assembly); income never leaves the device except as a zkTLS proof sent straight to the report verifier. The attestor's (S4 D2, no custody): the Merces attestor tool, a dedicated secp256k1 key in a Web3 Secret Storage v3 keystore that never leaves the machine, which checks a signing request against its own pinned network table, rebuilds Stage 1's digest from the typed fields, signs only that digest and proves the key to an account with an EIP-191 link proof.
